main.description: The drive's settings, which every device follows. How this record is stored is what says whether the drive is encrypted: sealed (only the sealed field) on an encrypted drive, plain on one that isn't. Written when the drive is created, when encryption is turned on or off, and when a device is removed.

retentionDays.description: How long history is kept. 30 if absent.

driveID.description: Random, made with the drive. A drive with another ID was wiped and created again.

generation.description: Counts the changes to this record. On an encrypted drive, a device refuses settings older than ones it has read.

converting.description: Encrypted drives: records that aren't sealed with the drive's keys are still read, while what was there before encryption was turned on is being encrypted.

retiredKeys.description: The drive's keys from when it was last encrypted, published when encryption was turned off: what's still sealed with them stays readable, and a device that held them can tell the drive's own devices turned encryption off.

sealed.description: On an encrypted drive: every other field, sealed.

sharingKey.description: Home drives: the account's sharing key (raw X25519 private key). Sealed with the rest on an encrypted drive; readable on a plain one, which its shareKey record says. Replaced when encryption is turned on or off.

name.description: Shares: the shared file's or folder's name, for those who open it.

file.description: Shares: it's one file (the space holds just that file), shown as the file rather than a folder.
